Automatisations recommandées
GitHub code review

Review requested pull-request heads, resume an outstanding reviewer request on a schedule once its checks are green, classify all open non-draft pull requests that nobody requested and review eligible green heads, drain the backlog oldest-first under a small per-scan new-conversation bound, record exact-head decisions, stop early on out-of-scope changes, and optionally request a code-aware human maintainer after approval or a maintainer-decision scope stop only when a successfully fetched same-repository closing issue has priority:medium or priority:high.

Custom automation

Create a custom automation from a prompt, plugin-powered prompt, or uploaded script tarball.

GitHub issue to PR

Implement ready GitHub issues, address pull request feedback, and publish tested changes for review.

Slack channel monitor

Watch Slack channels for @openhands mentions, open a conversation with the message context, reply when the agent finishes, and continue the same conversation from triggered Slack thread follow-ups.

AGENTS.md Maintainer

Keep AGENTS.md current in your repositories. On a schedule, an agent reads the repository, creates or updates AGENTS.md, and opens a pull request - and stays quiet while one of its pull requests is still open.

Daily news digest

Read a list of public RSS and Atom feeds on a schedule, hand an agent everything new, and have it pick out what matters for your topics and write a short digest. Connects to nothing and needs no credentials.

Slack standup digest

Summarize yesterday’s Slack activity into an async standup note with blockers, decisions, and owners.

Linear issue triage assistant

Classify new Linear issues, suggest labels, find duplicates, and ask clarifying questions.

Linear issue to GitHub PR

Watch Linear for implementation-ready issues, start an agent to make the requested code change, and open a GitHub pull request.

Linear issue to GitLab MR

Watch Linear for implementation-ready issues, start an agent to make the requested code change, and open a GitLab merge request.

Linear issue to Bitbucket PR

Watch Linear for implementation-ready issues, start an agent to make the requested code change, and open a Bitbucket pull request.

Jira issue to GitHub PR

Watch a Jira Cloud project for issues with a configurable label and automatically open a GitHub pull request for each new issue found. The target GitHub repo is read from the ticket body - no repo parameter required at deploy time.

Jira issue to GitLab MR

Watch a Jira Cloud project for issues with a configurable label and automatically open a GitLab merge request for each new issue found. The target GitLab project is read from the ticket body - no repo parameter required at deploy time.

Research brief writer

Monitor a topic, gather sources from the web, and publish a short brief for your team.

Jira issue to Bitbucket PR

Watch a Jira Cloud project for issues with a configurable label and automatically open a Bitbucket pull request for each new issue found. The target Bitbucket repo is read from the ticket body - no repo parameter required at deploy time.

server.compression: gzip level 6 for text-like MIME types when browser advertises gzip; Content-Length is encoded response bytes; otherwise identity

caveats: One run only; this is a critical-path observation, not a performance distribution or a Paraglide comparison.
The profile uses CDP latency=80 ms, which is not a calibrated 80 ms round-trip network.
The local static server uses HTTP/1 and explicit gzip, not production CDN TLS/HTTP2/HTTP3 behavior.
The mock build uses the app’s existing MSW fixture. Unhandled backend API failures are recorded; no app API behavior was changed.

responseFixtureAudit.settingsEndpoint: GET /api/settings is intercepted by src/mocks/settings-handlers.ts. In the unmodified mock fixture, misc_settings.app_preferences.language defaults to null; src/api/settings-service/settings-service.api.ts hoists that null onto settings.language, and src/routes/root-layout.tsx changes language only for a truthy settings.language.
responseFixtureAudit.observedLanguage: document.lang transitions from the static shell en to fr after i18next initializes; it stays fr during the 1500 ms post-ready observation window. No third locale catalog request occurred.
responseFixtureAudit.unhandledMockRequests: The existing MSW setup does not handle /api/meta-profiles or /api/automation/sdk-version; these fail against 127.0.0.1:8000 and are kept in browserNetwork.failed.

readiness.marker: home-screen visible and includes French HOME$WHAT_TO_WORK_ON literal "Sur quoi voulez-vous travailler ?" with document.documentElement.lang starting fr

transfer.meaning: static server response entity bytes (Content-Length), gzip level 6; not TLS/header wire bytes; MSW synthetic API bodies are excluded from server-byte sums
